It is read-only, side-effect free and not keyboard-reachable, so it is an observation surface and not an integration point, but it is the one globally reachable name the delivery adds; a later unit adding a setter would convert it into an attack surface.

WS-01 B-01 and ADR-005 section 4 require the install command and the test command to be stated as distinct steps or a verifier will read the evidence as self-contradictory.

Unit 3's needs from ENG-04 are stated in the document as open questions only: a submission contract, a server-side validation position, an identity decision that does not exist yet, the fact that endedAt carries no local offset, and the live AC-19 interpretation risk that Z may be read as insufficient against a numeric offset - one formatting function in Unit 1 but a data migration once a server persists it.
